notes.title: Roadmap (Update)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905335/7fc00400c616755a3a00ab897ca8993459bca252.png
Dear Friends!!!

My team and I had 2 hours of discussions and decided that we want to present you a much bigger and better game in terms of content than we originally planned.

At first we envisioned to make a game with only 15 levels and girls we will undress. Also achievements and a leaderboard. And the current version was ready at the beginning of April, which we can release.

While developing the game, new ideas came to us to make the game bigger and more interesting. At the moment we have already added 3 boosters and 3 sex scenes in the form of a comic book, which were not in the original plans.

Unfortunately, it takes a very long time to develop a comic for each level. And to realize them all, we need several months.

We also decided to add to the game:

 A full-fledged game story
 A prologue that immerses the player in a mysterious story
 A game divided into chapters that will be presented like a visual novel
 Dialogs with each girl
 Different modes of passing the level (easy, medium, difficult) - dialogs will differ from this.
 A global world map, on which we will get acquainted with different girls
 2 additional secondary characters


If you like our plans, please tell your friends about our game or post about it on social networks. We are trying hard and your opinion is important to us!

More game updates coming soon!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2874110

notes.title: The demo has been released!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905335/9066bfa0dc41c3d980cd83734f61304d074eda05.png
Hi everyone!!!
Just recently we released a demo version of our new Girls and Blocks game and you can try it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2874110

We would like to let you know that we will update our demo a few times, because we want to hear your feedback and fix any bugs we find. We will also add new mechanics to the game to make it more interesting!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905335/08ac6a42142a8355ccd243151a0296d65a6d6917.jpg

The longer we work on a project, the more we want to improve it and introduce new content that we didn't originally plan. Here are a few examples:

 Added boosters to the game
 Added level replay
 Updated the game interface


We also plan to implement in the near future:

 Add achievements
 Add the leaderboard
 Add the comic at the beginning of the game
 Add dialogs with each girl
 Add additional characters for the main plot


Don't forget to add our game to your wishlists! ❤️

Our Discord - https://discord.gg/P6Kz94Qj
